notes: Date Sheet screen: class filter and Preview/Download fixed. Islamic Corner removed from all menus. New Document Language setting for PDFs, separate from the app's display language. Forgot Password + Forgot Security Answer recovery added: admin can reset a user's password directly from Manage Users, and a Machine-ID-bound Emergency Reset Token flow was added to the login screen for when both are forgotten. Machine ID (hardware fingerprint) made more robust, with a compatibility fallback so licenses issued before this update keep working without needing to be reissued.
